'''Wrex''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] who worked for the criminal [[Big Bunji/Legends|Big Bunji]] as an envoy to all the Jawa clans that traded in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. He also worked as an effective spy since Jawas were not considered notable in the city. Wrex wore [[Color/Legends|blue]] robes instead of the brown ones considered traditional. He carried a [[Ion blaster/Legends|Jawa ionization blaster]] and a tool kit.<ref name="There's Many a Slip Betwixt Cup and Lip" />
